mapper.select: SELECT * FROM contract_fee WHERE institution_no = #{institutionNo} ORDER BY fee_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO contract_fee (institution_no, fee_amount, fee_date, payment_method, recorded_by, remark) VALUES (#{institutionNo}, #{feeAmount}, #{feeDate}, #{paymentMethod}, #{recordedBy}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contract_fee WHERE YEAR(fee_date) = #{year}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(fee_amount), 0) FROM contract_fee WHERE YEAR(fee_date) = #{year}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(fee_amount), 0) FROM contract_fee WHERE YEAR(create_time) = #{year}
